d: A woman  heads to L.A. to become a TV star  her nephew back in Alabama witnesses a racially motivated murder.
A federal agent is assigned to spy on his mother and her new lover, both suspects in an art theft ring.
After twenty years as the legendary Zorro, Don Diego must transform a troubled drifter into the fearless hero.
A threat to California's pending statehood causes adventure-loving husband and wife to take action.
